player_behavior: After a World is archived, desktop and Android keep existing Runs visible for review but disable Continue and New Run actions instead of letting the player enter a server-rejected path.
Restoring the World remains the explicit action that re-enables both continuing and starting independent Runs.
not_proven: The archived-world behavior is not yet verified through the packaged macOS WebView, Windows package or an Android physical device.
Android physical-device and Windows release acceptance remain blocked by the environment.
